build.sources: gitCommit plus the changes of the commit that adds or rewrites this metadata, rendered from that working tree before committing

comparison: Compared by tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp with G01's tolerance (6/255 per channel, at most 0.5% of the pixels) on this GPU and driver only.
description: Gate D golden of a floor's hall (I6 steps 1 and 2, ADR-0014, style 4 and 13.4, look.md's halls: rooms glow through their doorways, never black holes): the esde/building fixture's handheld floor, the walker on the hall's centre line east of its two doorways looking west to the elevator: the gb room's doorway on the right and the shared room's on the left, each under its portal with the room's lit sign and a blade sign, their rooms lit through them (the neighbours' lights through the doorway, the doorway fill), the handheld archive's dressed hall (dark warm plaster over a panelled wainscot, beams, sconces and muted prints in turn, a bench and a plant clear of the passage, the runner) and the elevator's doors under the floor's sign.

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it

fixture.name: esde/building
fixture.rule: SHA-256 of the lines "<relative path>\t<SHA-256 of the file>\n", sorted by path

run.regenerate: $env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1; build/msvc-x64-debug/bin/rv_smoke_tests.exe "golden/G18:*"; Remove-Item Env:RV_UPDATE_GOLDEN (then run it again without the variable; tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp)
steps: a first run of the same command but --frames 300 and without --video-freeze-pts, --spawn or --input-script: the plan generated and written, the covers into the cache

view: --start-room room:gb --spawn 3.85,0,6.65,270,-4: the floor's x 11.5 m on the hall's centre line, facing west (in room:gb's frame)
